verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

verses.html: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.text: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

verses.html: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.html: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

verses.html: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.text: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.html: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.text: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.html: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.text: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.html: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
verses.text: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

verses.html: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.html: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.html: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.text: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

verses.html: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

verses.html: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
